semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Sandvik Osprey Ltd. provides specialized materials that support semiconductor applications, particularly in thermal management and structural components.
summary: Sandvik Osprey Ltd. manufactures Controlled Expansion Alloys (CE-Alloys), which are high modulus, low density Aluminium-Silicon alloys with tailored thermal expansion properties. These materials are crucial for semiconductor applications, providing support, protection, and thermal management for devices and systems, especially in environments with extreme temperature variations.
capabilities: Build-to-print process for material selection and design
Production of finished components for thermal management
